title: Raspberry Bakewell Tart with Fresh Berries and Feathered Icing
summary: A buttery pastry case filled with almond frangipane and fresh raspberries, finished with a delicately feathered pink and white icing.
equipment: 23 cm fluted tart tin with removable base
2 small piping bags or freezer bags

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
cold unsalted butter, in 1 cm cubes
iced water, plus more if needed
fresh raspberries, plus a few to serve
raspberries, crushed and sieved for juice

steps.title: Pastry
steps.text: Rub 190 g flour, 8 g icing sugar and 115 g cold butter to fine crumbs, add 2 egg yolks and 1 tbsp iced water, bring together, then chill 30 min.

steps.title: Blind Bake
steps.text: Line a 23 cm tart tin with the pastry, chill 15 min, then bake at 190 °C with paper and beans for 15-20 min before baking uncovered 8-10 min more.

steps.title: Frangipane
steps.text: Beat 135 g butter and 135 g sugar until pale and fluffy, beat in 2 eggs one at a time, then fold in 135 g ground almonds.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread 100 g raspberry jam over the pastry base, scatter 100 g raspberries over, then cover with the frangipane.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until golden and a skewer comes out clean, 40-45 min, then cool completely.

steps.title: Ice
steps.text: Mix 120 g icing sugar with 4 tsp water to a thick icing, tint 2 tbsp of it pink with raspberry juice.

steps.title: Decorate
steps.text: Spread the white icing over the tart, pipe pink lines across and drag a cocktail stick through to feather, then leave to set 30 min.

tips: Chill the pastry well before and after lining the tin to stop it shrinking during blind baking.
Let the tart cool completely before icing so the icing sets on top rather than melting in.
Drag the cocktail stick through the icing in alternating directions for a neat feathered pattern.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keeps in an airtight container at room temperature for a couple of days, or chilled for longer; bring back to room temperature before serving.
